source: kristiannordby/sql-db, train split, 121 question/query pairs, columns question and query only
note: Original queries are audit provenance only. Spot templates are rewritten in SQLite, with no owner names and no YEAR(). Do not execute original queries directly.

adapted.original_question: What is the total number of sales made in 2022?
adapted.original_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales WHERE YEAR(sellDate) = 2022;
adapted.definition: Count of sales rows in the given calendar year.
adapted.template: SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM sales WHERE strftime('%Y', sale_date) = :year

adapted.original_question: What is the average price of cars sold?
adapted.definition: Average sale_price over all sales rows, no invoice-status filter in the source, so this is not core invoiced revenue.
adapted.template: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(sale_price), 0) AS v FROM sales

adapted.original_question: Which dealership had the highest total sales revenue in 2021?
adapted.original_query: SELECT d.dealershipName, SUM(s.sellPrice) AS total_sales FROM sales s JOIN dealerships d ON s.dealershipID = d.dealershipID WHERE YEAR(s.sellDate) = 2021 GROUP BY d.dealershipName ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1;
adapted.definition: Sum of sale_price in the given calendar year. Spot currency unit, not EGP, not core invoiced revenue.
adapted.template: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sale_price), 0) AS v FROM sales WHERE strftime('%Y', sale_date) = :year

adapted.original_question: Which dealership had the highest total sales revenue in 2021?
adapted.original_query: SELECT d.dealershipName, SUM(s.sellPrice) AS total_sales FROM sales s JOIN dealerships d ON s.dealershipID = d.dealershipID WHERE YEAR(s.sellDate) = 2021 GROUP BY d.dealershipName ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1;
adapted.definition: Dealership with the highest sum of sale_price in the given calendar year.
adapted.template: SELECT d.name AS name, COALESCE(SUM(s.sale_price), 0) AS v FROM dealerships d JOIN sales s ON s.dealership_id = d.dealership_id WHERE strftime('%Y', s.sale_date) = :year GROUP BY d.dealership_id, d.name ORDER BY v DESC LIMIT 1

adapted.original_question: How many cars have been serviced at least once?
adapted.definition: Count of distinct cars with at least one service record.
adapted.template: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT serial_num) AS v FROM service_records

adapted.original_question: What is the average service cost for all services done at 'Auto Service Center'?
adapted.original_query: SELECT AVG(serviceCost) FROM service_records WHERE serviceCenter = 'Auto Service Center';
adapted.definition: Average service_cost for the named service center, or for all centers when no center is given.
adapted.template: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(service_cost), 0) AS v FROM service_records WHERE (:center IS NULL OR service_center = :center)

adapted.original_question: What is the total service cost for cars that were sold for more than $30,000?
adapted.original_query: SELECT SUM(sr.serviceCost) FROM service_records sr JOIN sales s ON sr.serialNum = s.serialNum WHERE s.sellPrice > 30000;
adapted.definition: Spot version: sum of service_cost over all service records. The original price-threshold variant is a separate metric if ever governed.
adapted.template: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(service_cost), 0) AS v FROM service_records

adapted.original_question: Which cars have been serviced under warranty?
adapted.original_query: SELECT serialNum, serviceType FROM service_records WHERE warrantyCovered = TRUE;
adapted.definition: Spot version: count of service records with warranty_covered = 1. Car serials are not listed as manager output in this spot.
adapted.template: SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM service_records WHERE warranty_covered = 1
